name: Cross Ranch State Park - Governors Centennial Loop
note: Cross Ranch's main campground: a loop under cottonwoods on the Missouri River bottom beside the visitor center, with the group sites, cabins and yurts along the road north of it; the park's separate Sanger campground is about 3.6 km down the river. Water here stays on through winter; the dump station's water is shut off October 1. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: reserveNDparks Facility 36 'Governors Centennial Loop' (Cross Ranch SP, PlaceId 52), grid + search/details read 2026-11-12: 28 standard campsites #01-#29 (no #05; #30 is the host site) with level gravel pads 30-45 ft, 50-amp, 11 pull-through, all AllowWebBooking, $25 Tue / $30 Fri-Sat, plus 6 standard group sites (pads 56-120 ft); NDPRD campground map (Inset C) shows the loop with comfort station and dump station, separate from Sanger (Inset E, own lane off River Road, ~3.6 km S) and the tent-only Primitive area (Inset D); NDPRD park page '35 Standard Campsites' = 28 here + 7 at Sanger; ND HHS licensed list 07.17.2025 #84 Cross Ranch State Park / ND Parks & Recreation / 98 units; no horse camping anywhere in the park -> real state drive-in RV campground (public, no price gate)
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-12: Esri World Imagery (220 m frame at 47.2116,-100.9978 and z19 tiles at 47.2116,-100.9970, leaf-off) shows the loop's gravel spurs under cottonwoods with the east-side pads ~30-45 m from the Missouri's bank edge across a continuous belt of cottonwoods and brush with a riverside trail along the bank; no pad has open ground to the water. NDPRD campground map Inset C draws the loop inland with water only beyond the group-site road to the NE. No official site photos found to support a filtered view (reserveNDparks unit images are placeholders), so default down. DEM 508 m at the loop vs ~502 m at the bank (Open-Meteo); no dam.

fees.note: Standard 50-amp sites $25, $30 on Friday and Saturday nights; the six standard group sites are $25 a unit ($30 Friday-Saturday). reserveNDparks, read 2026-11-12.

fees_source: reserveNDparks search/details (https://ndparksrdr.usedirect.com/rdr/rdr/) Facility 36: all 34 campsite units Rate 25.00 for Tue 2026-11-17; units #01 and group #31 Rate 30.00 for Fri 2026-11-20 and Sat 2026-11-21, read 2026-11-12; repo samples audit/state_park_fees/nd_booking_rates_june_2026-10-12.jsonl (#01 $25 Tue 2027-06-15, $30 Sat 2027-06-19); park page https://www.parkrec.nd.gov/cross-ranch-state-park ('Standard Campsites ... Price: $25-30 per night'; 'Group Standard Campsites ... Price: $25-30 per night, per unit'), read 2026-11-12
booking_source: https://www.parkrec.nd.gov/cross-ranch-state-park ('Campsites can be booked 95 days in advance'; 'Reservations can be made online or by calling 800-807-4723'); reserveNDparks Facility 36 grid: every campsite AllowWebBooking true, Restrictions MinimumStay 1 / MaximumStay 14, read 2026-11-12

sites.note: 28 standard sites (gravel pads 30-45 ft, 11 pull-through) and 6 standard group sites for 2-3 units (pads 56-120 ft); cabins and yurts not counted.

season_source: https://www.parkrec.nd.gov/limited-service-season ('While North Dakota state park campgrounds are open year-round, the department shifts to limited services fall through the spring'; Cross Ranch: water in the main campground stays on through winter, dump station water off October 1), read 2026-11-12
rvlife: 3.5*/$$ (RV Life listing 'Cross Ranch State Park - Main Primitive', 47.21379,-100.99977, avg_rate 32; read 2026-11-12. Its pin is ~250 m N of this loop by the visitor center, so it may stand for this loop, the old primitive area, or both)
flags: Separate from 5894 Sanger: ~3.6 km apart; NDPRD main map Inset B shows Sanger on its own lane off River Road at the park's south end, while this loop is reached through the main park entrance by the visitor center (Inset A). Different reserveNDparks facilities (36 vs 38).
Replaces dropped 5893 (tent-only Primitive Campground, Facility 37, ~635 m NE at 47.21721,-100.99305); 5893 is no longer in campgrounds.json.
Pin: reserveNDparks' facility point 47.21305,-100.99616 lands near the yurts ~200 m NE of the loop; pinned to the loop centre seen on imagery (47.2116,-100.9978). Units carry no coordinates.

hookups: electric 50 from 'Amp Service 50' on every campsite unit. Water and sewer left out (unknown): the units carry no water/sewer hookup amenity (Sanger's carry an explicit 'Water Hook-up on Site No'), and 'Distance to Drinking Water' is 1,060-2,115 ft on standard sites, which suggests no water at the sites. An aggregator (rvshare) says water yes; not used.

facilities from the NDPRD campground map Inset C (comfort station, trailer dump station, vault toilet, playground at this loop) and the park page ('Showers & flush toilets', 'Sewer dump station'); potable water from the limited-service page and unit 'Distance to Drinking Water'.

Group sites: 'Standard Group Site 2-3 Units' (#31, #33, #34, #35) and '2 Units' (#05, #32), MinAdult 2 per details; kept in the count but not used for price or waterfront. #31/#33/#35 sit along the road near the river NE of the loop; a group site is not a waterfront call for the campground (same handling as Sanger's #66).

Waterfront: east-side loop sites (map numbers ~19-23) are ~30-45 m from the bank behind a cottonwood belt; leaf-on, a filtered river view from those sites is possible but unproven, so not waterfront. A 2019 Dyrt reviewer mentions 'beautiful views of Missouri River' (park-wide, not a site claim).
Fees: weekend +$5 carried in surcharges as on 5894; reservation fee, entrance permit and stay limits are on the state:ND policy row.
No horse camping in the park (park page and maps show none).
